## Checklist

- [ ] One responsibility per PR; split mixed work into separate PRs
- [ ] PR title uses conventional commits: `type: short summary` (feat, fix, docs, test, refactor, chore, ci)
- [ ] Squashed to one commit
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass locally, CI green
- [ ] JSDoc on new or changed functions
- [ ] If this PR changes the UI: I uploaded before and after images
- [ ] Reviewer is not the author
